---
title: "Identification of independent exposures"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
  echo: true
---

## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(car)
  library(caret)
  library(broom)
})

analysis_matrix_path <- "results/01_ewas/ewas_analysis_matrix.rds"
replicated_ewas_path <- "data/replicated_ewas.tsv"
exposure_metadata_path <- "data/exposure_metadata.csv"
result_dir <- "results/02_independent_exposures"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

correlation_cutoff <- 0.90
vif_cutoff <- 3
p_cutoff <- 1e-6
cluster_fraction <- 0.30

quote_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("`", gsub("`", "", x, fixed = TRUE), "`")
}
```

## Inputs and min-max scaling

```{r}
analysis_df <- readRDS(analysis_matrix_path)
replicated_ewas <- readr::read_tsv(
  replicated_ewas_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
exposure_metadata <- readr::read_csv(
  exposure_metadata_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

exposures <- unique(replicated_ewas$Exposure)

minmax_scale <- function(x) {
  (x - min(x, na.rm = TRUE)) /
    (max(x, na.rm = TRUE) - min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

analysis_df <- analysis_df |>
  mutate(across(all_of(exposures), minmax_scale))

exposure_sex <- exposure_metadata |>
  transmute(
    FieldID = as.character(FieldID),
    Sexed = as.character(Sexed)
  )
```

## Exposure clustering

```{r}
cluster_exposures <- function(data, metabolite_exposures) {
  field_ids <- stringr::str_split_i(metabolite_exposures, "#", 1)
  sex_labels <- exposure_sex$Sexed[match(field_ids, exposure_sex$FieldID)]

  sex_specific <- metabolite_exposures[sex_labels %in% c("Male", "Female")]
  general <- setdiff(metabolite_exposures, sex_specific)

  cluster_rows <- tibble(exposure = character(), cluster_id = integer())

  if (length(general) == 1) {
    cluster_rows <- tibble(exposure = general, cluster_id = 1L)
  }

  if (length(general) > 1) {
    exposure_matrix <- data |>
      select(all_of(general)) |>
      as.matrix() |>
      t()

    clustering <- hclust(dist(exposure_matrix), method = "ward.D2")
    cut_index <- length(general) - ceiling(length(general) * cluster_fraction)
    cut_height <- clustering$height[cut_index]
    cluster_rows <- tibble(
      exposure = names(cutree(clustering, h = cut_height)),
      cluster_id = unname(cutree(clustering, h = cut_height))
    )
  }

  next_cluster <- if (nrow(cluster_rows) == 0) 0L else max(cluster_rows$cluster_id)
  female_exposures <- metabolite_exposures[sex_labels == "Female"]
  male_exposures <- metabolite_exposures[sex_labels == "Male"]

  bind_rows(
    cluster_rows,
    tibble(exposure = female_exposures, cluster_id = next_cluster + 1L),
    tibble(exposure = male_exposures, cluster_id = next_cluster + 2L)
  )
}
```

## Correlation, VIF, and P-value filtering

```{r}
filter_correlation <- function(data, exposure_names) {
  if (length(exposure_names) < 2) return(exposure_names)
  correlation_matrix <- cor(
    data[, exposure_names, drop = FALSE],
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
  )
  remove_index <- caret::findCorrelation(
    correlation_matrix,
    cutoff = correlation_cutoff
  )
  if (length(remove_index) == 0) return(exposure_names)
  exposure_names[-remove_index]
}

filter_vif <- function(data, metabolite, exposure_names) {
  retained <- exposure_names
  while (length(retained) > 1) {
    model_df <- data |>
      select(all_of(c(metabolite, retained))) |>
      drop_na()
    model_fit <- lm(
      reformulate(quote_name(retained), quote_name(metabolite)),
      data = model_df
    )
    vif_values <- car::vif(model_fit)
    names(vif_values) <- stringr::str_remove_all(names(vif_values), "`")
    if (max(vif_values) <= vif_cutoff) break
    retained <- setdiff(retained, names(which.max(vif_values)))
  }
  retained
}

filter_pvalue <- function(data, metabolite, exposure_names, covariates) {
  retained <- exposure_names
  while (length(retained) > 1) {
    model_df <- data |>
      select(all_of(c(metabolite, retained, covariates))) |>
      drop_na()
    model_fit <- lm(
      reformulate(c(covariates, quote_name(retained)), quote_name(metabolite)),
      data = model_df
    )
    exposure_p <- broom::tidy(model_fit) |>
      mutate(term = stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`")) |>
      filter(term %in% retained) |>
      select(term, p.value)
    if (all(exposure_p$p.value <= p_cutoff)) break
    retained <- setdiff(retained, exposure_p$term[which.max(exposure_p$p.value)])
  }
  retained
}

covariates <- intersect(
  c("Sex", "Age", "Fasting", "Month", "Center"),
  names(analysis_df)
)

independent_exposures <- map_dfr(
  unique(replicated_ewas$Metabolite),
  function(metabolite) {
    metabolite_exposures <- replicated_ewas |>
      filter(Metabolite == metabolite) |>
      pull(Exposure) |>
      unique()

    clusters <- cluster_exposures(analysis_df, metabolite_exposures)

    clusters |>
      group_by(cluster_id) |>
      summarise(
        retained = list({
          after_correlation <- filter_correlation(
            analysis_df,
            exposure
          )
          after_vif <- filter_vif(
            analysis_df,
            metabolite,
            after_correlation
          )
          filter_pvalue(
            analysis_df,
            metabolite,
            after_vif,
            covariates
          )
        }),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      unnest_longer(retained, values_to = "Exposure") |>
      mutate(Metabolite = metabolite)
  }
) |>
  left_join(replicated_ewas, by = c("Metabolite", "Exposure"))

readr::write_tsv(
  independent_exposures,
  file.path(result_dir, "independent_exposures.tsv")
)
```
